title: Built for modern travellers.
subtitle: Getly was created to remove financial and connectivity friction for global citizens, digital nomads, and frequent flyers.
whyP1: Traveling internationally, moving across borders, or working remotely should not require managing five fragmented apps — one for currency conversion, another for local SIM cards, a third for virtual cards, and a fourth for flight bookings.
whyP2: Getly brings every essential travel tool into one connected companion. Under the hood, one global multi-currency wallet powers instant virtual cards, high-speed eSIM data in 180+ countries, direct flight booking, and intelligent AI trip planning.
